question: India won their first women's under-19 T20 Cricket World Cup 2023 by defeating:
solution:
The correct answer is __**England**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India** won their first women's **under-19 **T20 Cricket World Cup in **2023**.
 
• **The victory was against England, making them the runners-up in the tournament.**
 
• The tournament was specifically for **under-19** women's teams.</l
